notes.title: Friendy Sheeps is Now Released!
notes.content:
Hello, Friendly Sheep Community!

We thank you all for your overwhelming support, which greatly exceeded my expectations! It melts my heart to know that thousands of people have had exciting hours with our little sheep-farming game.

Here is the update notes for Friendly Sheep
with your precious feedback, and what we sprinkle on top of it:


Added Achievments

 16 new Achievments have ben added to the game.

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45172141/266128f33833916b55a169adbad7e323a973cc15.png

Added Special Drop Box Cart
You can now fullfill Orders from Villagers with requests. Complete them and get money. But be carefull they have time. There are around 50 orders balanced by level, the higher the level better the reward.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45172141/2ed7596685f8979f7c59f32da8f51f2ef7ca2d42.png

🆕 UI Redesign – Better, Faster, More Immersive!
We’re thrilled to introduce a major UI overhaul that enhances both the look and usability of the game. We’ve taken your feedback into account and redesigned key elements to ensure a smoother, more immersive experience. Whether you're a new player or a veteran, you’ll notice an immediate improvement in navigation, readability, and overall aesthetics!

We’d love to hear what you think! Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping this update, and we’re always looking for ways to improve even further. Let us know your thoughts in the comments or on our Discord!

Jump in and check out the new UI now! We hope this makes your time in Friendly Sheeps even more enjoyable. As always, thanks for your support!

Quick Fix
 Fixed items going out of the farm.
 Fixed when changing the name of the animal the players action didn't stop.
 Adjusted some fonts and text sizes.
 Adjusted some Translations.


If you have any ideas, feature requests, or encounter any kind of bug, please don't hesitate to tell us!
Click here to join our Discord.

Hope you enjoy v.1.0.04!

Thanks,
ACGames

notes.title: Quick Fix EA_v0.0.02b
notes.content:
Hello, Friendly Sheep Community!

Unfortunately, the Save/Load system had a bug when a new release was released that caused it to not read the position of buildables correctly. For these reasons, unfortunately, players with a started section will have to start from the beginning and for that I am deeply sorry.


 Changed the way how the game was saved and loaded.


If you have any ideas, feature requests, or encounter any kind of bug, please don't hesitate to tell us!
Click here to join our Discord.

Hope you enjoy v.1.0.03!

Thanks,
ACGames

notes.title: Version 1.0.02 Update is Available
notes.content:
Hello, Friendly Sheep Community!

We thank you all for your overwhelming support, which greatly exceeded our expectations! It melts our hearts to know that thousands of people have had exciting hours with our little sheep-farming game.

Foremost, I should say that I am a solo developer, and I am very approachable 7/24 via our Discord server! We consider every suggestion/idea/feedback/criticism and are working hard to implement them to make Friendly Sheep the best game about Sheep in the world!

https://i.ibb.co/9hwrj8k/gif2.gif

https://i.ibb.co/n7MNbBd/gif3.gif

Here is the first after-launch update notes for Friendly Sheep
with your precious feedback, and what we sprinkle on top of it:


 Add Mouse Sensitivity settings to options.
 Add Option to increase/decrease the quantity of items to buy.
 Add Option to view all animal needs.
 Decrease the money needed for Tough Times Quest from 150 to 100.
 Several UI elements have been changed.
 Updated some screenshots on the Store Page


We also made a lot of minor fixes and optimizations.
If you have any ideas, feature requests, or encounter any kind of bug, please don't hesitate to tell us!
Click here to join our Discord.

Hope you enjoy v.1.0.02!

Thanks,
ACGames
